feeds.description: Wildlife Tourism Australia promotes a strong, diverse wildlife tourism industry that supports conservation. Find wildlife holidays, research resources and more.

feeds.title: Australian Geographic Blog
feeds.description: Australian Geographic captures the essence and spirit of Australia through its meticulously crafted and beautifully presented stories and photography in print and online.Our team of journalists, photographers and editors seek to inspire, educate and entertain, connecting readers to Australian landscapes, plants and animals, science, industry and people.

feeds.title: Echidna Walkabout Blog
feeds.description: All the latest wildlife news from wildlife specialist tour operator Echidna Walkabout Nature Tours. Janine Duffy and Roger Smith founded Echidna Walkabout in 1993, and since then we have been providing high quality nature and wildlife experiences for small groups of international and domestic travellers.

feeds.title: Wildlife Tours Blog
feeds.description: Articles on most entertaining, informative, exciting and enjoyable tours in Australia. Wildlife Tours Australia offers an exciting range of tours to Great Ocean Road, Phillip Island Penguin Parade, Grampians, Melbourne to Adelaide and many more.

feeds.title: Animal Impact Blog
feeds.description: Follow to read importance of wildlife for ecosystems, conservation and human survival, why animals matter, the role of wildlife at Animal Impact blog. Simon shares stories, that can help you understand the critical role animals play in making a habitable Earth. Simon has been studying and observing wildlife for nearly 50 years and for about 30 of that, writing stories, taking photographs, and making short films.

feeds.title: Quolling Around
feeds.description: Quolling Around, a blog detailing both adventures around the Australian Continent finding rare wildlife, and, trekking famous long-distance Australian walks.

feeds.title: Naturally South Australia
feeds.description: This blog explores the fascinating wild places and animals that define South Australia. Explore the fascinating wild places and animals that define South Australia.

feeds.title: Life Images by Jill Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Life Images by Jill, stepping into the light and bringing together the images and stories of our world.I am a photographer, writer and multi-media artist. Through my blog I am seeking to preserve images and memories of the beautiful world in which we live and the people in it.

feeds.title: Working with Australian Wildlife Blog
feeds.description: I am Helen Hardy. Welcome to my blog! I am passionate about animals and their welfare, especially wildlife. I've been working with Australian wildlife for over 15 years.

feeds.title: MaryseJansenArt
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to celebrating the beauty of nature, which is the inspiration for my work. Australia has an excellent and unique natural world, which many Australians take for granted and others know little about. In this blog I share my discoveries in the form of images, stories about the pictures, and interesting facts about what you see in the photos.

feeds.title: Wildlife Matters
feeds.description: Celebrating the Australian Wildlife with great articles and pictures from our wildlife carers. A blog about Sydney Wildlife Rescue and Australian wildlife.
